title: animsmith measurements v18
description: Animation measurements including artifact-derived per-bone TRS channel coverage, sampled normalized-model-space Root/Hips trajectory evidence, loop endpoint and declared frame-grid evidence, explicit per-bone loop-continuity availability, per-primitive finite geometry summaries, bounded unsupported-image magic evidence, plus static scene-bound, source material-resource, and source skeleton/rest-pose transform-domain measurements shared by measure and lint output. Every clip fact that is not applicable to every clip carries a sibling `_availability` status distinguishing `not_applicable` (this clip has no subject for the fact) from `unavailable` (the subject applies, but derivation failed); the value field is present exactly when that status is `measured`.

bone_channels.description: Canonical set of non-empty local TRS channels present in the measured document, grouped by skeleton bone index. This describes artifact coverage, not requested transforms, removed-track evidence, or track multiplicity.

bone_rotation_range_deg.description: Maximum rotation deviation for structurally valid keyed rotation channels above the recording floor. Every key is also present in animated_bones; that cross-field invariant is enforced by the core contract validator.

properties.description: Non-empty canonical subset in translation, rotation, scale order.
